items.rationale: Translating the police report is claim substantiation cost. It is excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f).
This is working material raised alongside a translation charge. It is excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

items.description: Compensation for stolen watch (premium upgrade model)
items.rationale: 7.1.9 first limits the line to a like-for-like replacement (about EUR 7,000 or more). The valuables per-item sub-limit of EUR 2,500 under 4.2.2/4.4 then caps it, within the EUR 5,000 away-from-premises limit. The EUR 150 deductible is taken once here: 2,500 - 150 = 2,350.

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: Cash of about EUR 900 was taken by force. It is capped by the means-of-payment sub-limit of EUR 500 under 2.3.2/4.2.3.
The sunglasses were mislaid on a separate occasion without force or threat. They are excluded under 2.3.4(a) and are not an affected item under 7.1.5/7.1.10.
Carriage and delivery charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b) and are not covered by 5.2.3.
